execution.scope: One bounded incremental entry review; CPU fixtures and frozen small-file identity checks only

verdict.decision: Accept exact v2 package as entry to already authorized failed-route read-only localization

review.handoff: Root/A018 may install the A007 gate at the frozen engineering-owned gate path and launch under existing authorization

fixed_finding.original: v1 get_nodes returned one node and get_tiles returned empty; zero data rows were written while complete_node_export=1. Final seed missing native objects also appeared as blank mapping fields.
fixed_finding.fix: v2 writes at least one row per selected node, with NOT_MEASURED tile and UNKNOWN SLR/clock region when needed; separates selected/exported node counts, node row count, unknown mapping count and region_mapping_complete. Missing final seeds carry explicit missing evidence.
fixed_finding.complete_export_vs_mapping: complete_node_export=1 means all observed nodes exported; mapping can still be incomplete. region_mapping_complete is for the selected sample only; a complete whole-net mapped export additionally requires complete_node_export=1. Zero nodes is explicit node_count=0 with region_mapping_complete=0.
fixed_finding.native_query_error_behavior: get_nodes error is recorded as unavailable; an uncaught tile/property error reaches top-level native failure and cannot produce successful native completion.

classification_review.coverage: All 21 source-SLR/nonempty-load-set combinations, ambiguity/unknown/top-port/direction cases, retained constant/control types, high fanout census retention and bounded class sampling. Four exclusive endpoint classes sum to the canonical denominator; exclusive native type combinations also sum.
classification_review.source1_multicast: SOURCE1_MULTICAST_TO_0_AND_2 is separately counted from DIRECT_SOURCE_LOAD_0_TO_2. A source in SLR1 with loads in SLR0 and SLR2 demands both adjacent boundaries but does not imply one source-to-load path traverses both.
classification_review.interpretation: LOCAL_ENDPOINTS and adjacent/two-boundary categories describe minimum endpoint demand only. They do not prove actual route containment or establish where all resource conflicts occur.
classification_review.raw_classification_subtypes: Existing endpoint_class_coverage.json already emits two_boundary_subtypes; any offline exposition uses these/raw outputs without new native scope.

scope_checks.full_census: Full native CONFLICTS collection and canonical alias/actual-leaf-pin/top-port census retained from reviewed scalar mechanism; no sample used to estimate primary module contribution.
scope_checks.scalar_mechanism: Previously reviewed exact-name resolution, alias closure/cache, per-element NAME/handle verification and scalar-safe property path reused unchanged.
scope_checks.high_fanout: Excluded from deep sample only, retained in the full census and denominator.
scope_checks.node_cap: 2048 bounds written node samples; get_nodes still obtains the full native node collection/count for each selected net.
scope_checks.empty_supplements: protection_queries/net_seed_queries/known_cross_slr_net_seeds empty; inherited unused old plan metadata does not execute old-DCP queries.
scope_checks.seed_identity: 36 literal net names and 10 final hotspot nodes match bound AT006 final-log top10 section, frozen plan and exact Tcl literals.
scope_checks.device_mapping: Uses native SLR/clock-region/site/tile relations. No LOC, textual X/Y range or net-name inference; unknown native mappings retained.
scope_checks.light_vs_deep_completion: attribution_manifest is written after light full census and before bounded route capture. final_native_deep_capture=false remains in that light manifest; native_completed.txt is the independent final deep-completion signal. Do not interpret light manifest as completed deep capture.
scope_checks.denominators: Raw native conflict object count, canonical net count, reported 615840 and 797175 node overlaps remain separate; differences remain explicit, consumer/region incidence is non-additive.

entry_checks.DCP_binding: Owner actual HW-cwd prepare hashed full checkpoint; reviewer reused bound owner evidence and did not rehash/read DCP.
entry_checks.launch_gate: Requires no_substantive_blocker=true, exact package identity and exact A007 review identity before creating a fresh report/native launch.
entry_checks.prior_terminal_closure: AT006 native1, natural failure, stop_reason=null, no owned survivors; 50 identity receipts ended, 205 current/archive source checks match, lock_free=true. Reviewer checked bound closure receipt only, no live process/lock polling.
entry_checks.resource_policy_reused: A018 sole owner; CPU0-7/max8/nice5, RSS192GiB, MemAvailable48GiB/30s, disk30GiB, unique EDA lock, owned PID/start drain, no wall/silence stop; three RTL/G2 binding and source archives retained.
entry_checks.no_design_mutation: No synth/opt/place/physopt/route/write_checkpoint/read_xdc/set_property/bitstream in executed diagnostic scope; only native read queries and CPU aggregation.

result_limit: This entry acceptance establishes neither successful native localization nor proof of the middle-SLR shared-corridor hypothesis. It authorizes no new design change or implementation and is not required before reporting already available native failure reports.
